key_themes: Media sector restructuring as Comcast announces NBCUniversal/Sky spinoff, sparking cable M&A speculation
Space sector M&A: Rocket Lab acquires Iridium in $8B deal, lifting satellite stocks broadly
Tech/semiconductor relief rally as US-Iran diplomatic talks resume, easing geopolitical risk
